scope: Grid input masks of one user-owned commercial FW13 tonepack as serialised by the FM3 (counts only; tools/fm3/tonepack-structure-evidence.mjs). Compared with the FW10 factory corpus (references/fm3-factory-grid-evidence.json) and the 2026-10-24 store check (references/fm3-bit4-check-20261024.json).
findings: No cell of the FW13 corpus uses mask bit 4 or any bit above 3 (0 of 8463 occupied cells), although it has 22 merges in 18 presets and 679 splits.

Merges and splits are fully described by bits 0-3 in FW13-saved presets; bit 4 is not needed to write them. The 8 factory cells with bit 4 come from FW10 banks converted by the device, and the 2026-10-24 check showed the FM3 keeps the bit on STORE without showing it in LAYOUT.
The generator therefore keeps writing bits 0-3 only. The meaning of bit 4 itself is still unknown (it may be a FW10-era flag); no hardware test was made for this receipt.
